  • Method Details

    • registerNickname

      void registerNickname(String nickname, ClientHandler handler)
      Registers a player with the given nickname and associates it with the provided client handler. Sends the player information about the active lobbies he can join. If the player is already registered but not active, it reconnects the player and generates a snapshot of the game they are in.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player to register
      handler - the client handler associated with the player

    • newGame

      LobbyInterface newGame(Player creator, Level level, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new lobby for a game of the chosen level and with the specified number of players, adding the creator to it
      Parameters:
      creator - nickname of the lobby creator
      level - level of the game
      numPlayers - number of players in the game
      Returns:
      the LobbyInterface of the created lobby

    • joinLobby

      LobbyInterface joinLobby(Player player, UUID lobbyID)
      Adds the player with the specified nickname to the lobby with the given lobby ID
      Parameters:
      player - the nickname of the player joining a lobby
      lobbyID - the ID of the lobby the player wants to join
      Returns:
      the LobbyInterface of the lobby the player has just entered

    • handlePlayerDisconnection

      void handlePlayerDisconnection(Player player)
      Removes the given player from the active players in the server and, if the player was in a lobby, notifies other players in the lobby of the disconnection, otherwise it removes the player from the registered players.
      Parameters:
      player - the player who has disconnected
